verses.text: They said, “Some John the Baptist; others Elijah; still others Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
verses.display_text: They said, “Some John the Baptist; others Elijah; still others Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

verses.text: He said to them, “But you, who do you say I am?”
verses.display_text: He said to them, “But you, who do you say I am?”

verses.text: Simon Peter answered, “Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
verses.display_text: Simon Peter answered, “Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah, because flesh and blood did not reveal this to you, but My Father in the heavens.
verses.display_text: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah, because flesh and blood did not reveal this to you, but My Father in the heavens.

verses.text: And I tell you that you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build My Church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.
verses.display_text: And I tell you that you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build My Church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.

verses.text: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of the heavens. Whatever you bind upon earth will have been bound in the heavens, and whatever you loose upon earth will have been loosed in the heavens.”

verses.text: From then on Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem, suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, be killed, and on the third day be raised.

verses.display_text: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him, saying, “May mercy be Thine, Lord! This shall certainly never happen to Thee.”

verses.display_text: But He turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me, because you do not set your mind on the things of God, but on the things of human beings.”

verses.text: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “If anyone wishes to come after Me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.
verses.display_text: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “If anyone wishes to come after Me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.

verses.text: For whoever wishes to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life because of Me will find it.
verses.display_text: For whoever wishes to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life because of Me will find it.

verses.text: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His garments became white like the light.

verses.text: And behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them, conversing with Him.
verses.display_text: And behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them, conversing with Him.

verses.display_text: Peter answered Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If Thou wishest, I will make three tents here: one for Thee, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

verses.text: He answered, “Elijah indeed comes and will restore all things.
verses.display_text: He answered, “Elijah indeed comes and will restore all things.

verses.display_text: Therefore whoever humbles himself like this child is greatest in the kingdom of the heavens.

verses.display_text: And whoever receives one such child in My name receives Me.

verses.display_text: If your hand or foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away from you. It is better for you to enter life maimed or lame than, having two hands or two feet, to be cast into the eternal fire.

verses.display_text: And if your eye causes you to stumble, tear it out and throw it away from you. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than, having two eyes, to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

verses.text: See that you do not despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that their angels in the heavens continually see the face of My Father in the heavens.
verses.display_text: See that you do not despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that their angels in the heavens continually see the face of My Father in the heavens.

verses.display_text: What do you think? If someone has a hundred sheep and one of them strays, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the mountains and go seeking the one that strays?

verses.text: If he succeeds in finding it, truly I tell you that he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine that have not strayed.
verses.display_text: If he succeeds in finding it, truly I tell you that he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine that have not strayed.

verses.text: In the same way, it is not the will of your Father in the heavens that one of these little ones perish.
verses.display_text: In the same way, it is not the will of your Father in the heavens that one of these little ones perish.

verses.text: If your brother sins against you, go and reprove him between you and him alone. If he hears you, you have gained your brother.
verses.display_text: If your brother sins against you, go and reprove him between you and him alone. If he hears you, you have gained your brother.

verses.text: But if he does not hear, take one or two more with you, so that every matter may be established upon the mouth of two or three witnesses.
verses.display_text: But if he does not hear, take one or two more with you, so that every matter may be established upon the mouth of two or three witnesses.

verses.text: If he refuses to hear them, tell the Church. And if he refuses to hear even the Church, let him be to you like the Gentile and the tax collector.
verses.display_text: If he refuses to hear them, tell the Church. And if he refuses to hear even the Church, let him be to you like the Gentile and the tax collector.

verses.text: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind upon earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever you loose upon earth will have been loosed in heaven.
verses.display_text: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind upon earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever you loose upon earth will have been loosed in heaven.

verses.text: Again, truly I tell you that if two of you agree upon earth concerning any matter they ask, it will be done for them by My Father in the heavens.
verses.display_text: Again, truly I tell you that if two of you agree upon earth concerning any matter they ask, it will be done for them by My Father in the heavens.

verses.text: For where two or three are gathered into My name, there I am in their midst.”
verses.display_text: For where two or three are gathered into My name, there I am in their midst.”

verses.display_text: Then Peter came and said to Him, “Lord, how often will my brother sin against me and I forgive him? Up to seven times?”

verses.text: Jesus says to him, “I tell you, not up to seven times, but up to seventy times seven.
verses.display_text: Jesus says to him, “I tell you, not up to seven times, but up to seventy times seven.

verses.text: Therefore the kingdom of the heavens was likened to a king who wished to settle accounts with his slaves.
verses.display_text: Therefore the kingdom of the heavens was likened to a king who wished to settle accounts with his slaves.

verses.text: And when he began to settle them, one was brought to him who owed ten thousand talents.
verses.display_text: And when he began to settle them, one was brought to him who owed ten thousand talents.

verses.text: And since he did not have the means to repay, his master commanded that he be sold, with his wife and children and all that he had, and that payment be made.
verses.display_text: And since he did not have the means to repay, his master commanded that he be sold, with his wife and children and all that he had, and that payment be made.

verses.display_text: The slave therefore fell down and did him homage, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you everything.’

verses.text: And the master of that slave, moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the loan.
verses.display_text: And the master of that slave, moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the loan.

verses.text: But that slave went out and found one of his fellow slaves who owed him a hundred denarii. He seized him and began choking him, saying, ‘Repay whatever you owe.’
verses.display_text: But that slave went out and found one of his fellow slaves who owed him a hundred denarii. He seized him and began choking him, saying, ‘Repay whatever you owe.’

verses.text: So his fellow slave fell down and pleaded with him, saying, ‘Be patient with me, and I will repay you.’
verses.display_text: So his fellow slave fell down and pleaded with him, saying, ‘Be patient with me, and I will repay you.’

verses.text: But he was unwilling. Instead, he went and threw him into prison until he repaid what was owed.
verses.display_text: But he was unwilling. Instead, he went and threw him into prison until he repaid what was owed.

verses.text: When his fellow slaves saw what had happened, they were exceedingly grieved. They came and explained to their master everything that had happened.
verses.display_text: When his fellow slaves saw what had happened, they were exceedingly grieved. They came and explained to their master everything that had happened.

verses.display_text: Should you not also have had mercy on your fellow slave, as I had mercy on you?’

verses.display_text: His master became angry and handed him over to the torturers until he repaid everything owed.

verses.text: So also My heavenly Father will do to you, unless each of you forgives his brother from your hearts.”
verses.display_text: So also My heavenly Father will do to you, unless each of you forgives his brother from your hearts.”

verses.display_text: When Jesus finished these words, He departed from Galilee and came into the territories of Judea beyond the Jordan.

verses.display_text: Pharisees came to Him, testing Him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any cause?”

verses.text: But the greatest among you will be your servant.
verses.display_text: But the greatest among you will be your servant.

verses.text: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
verses.display_text: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you shut the kingdom of the heavens before people! For you do not enter, nor do you permit those entering to enter.
verses.display_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you shut the kingdom of the heavens before people! For you do not enter, nor do you permit those entering to enter.

verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you travel around sea and dry land to make one proselyte, and when he becomes one, you make him a son of Gehenna twice as much as yourselves!
verses.display_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you travel around sea and dry land to make one proselyte, and when he becomes one, you make him a son of Gehenna twice as much as yourselves!

verses.text: Woe to you, blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the sanctuary, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the sanctuary is bound.’
verses.display_text: Woe to you, blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the sanctuary, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the sanctuary is bound.’

verses.text: Fools and blind men! For which is greater, the gold or the sanctuary that sanctified the gold?
verses.display_text: Fools and blind men! For which is greater, the gold or the sanctuary that sanctified the gold?

verses.text: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift upon it is bound.’
verses.display_text: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift upon it is bound.’

verses.text: Blind men! For which is greater, the gift or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
verses.display_text: Blind men! For which is greater, the gift or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

verses.text: Therefore the one swearing by the altar swears by it and by everything upon it.
verses.display_text: Therefore the one swearing by the altar swears by it and by everything upon it.

verses.text: The one swearing by the sanctuary swears by it and by the One dwelling in it.
verses.display_text: The one swearing by the sanctuary swears by it and by the One dwelling in it.

verses.text: The one swearing by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One seated upon it.
verses.display_text: The one swearing by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One seated upon it.

verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, but have left aside the weightier matters of the Law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness! These you ought to have done without leaving those aside.
verses.display_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, but have left aside the weightier matters of the Law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness! These you ought to have done without leaving those aside.

verses.text: Blind guides, straining out the gnat but swallowing the camel!
verses.display_text: Blind guides, straining out the gnat but swallowing the camel!

verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you cleanse the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of plunder and self-indulgence!
verses.display_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you cleanse the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of plunder and self-indulgence!

verses.text: Blind Pharisee, first cleanse the inside of the cup, so that its outside may also become clean.
verses.display_text: Blind Pharisee, first cleanse the inside of the cup, so that its outside may also become clean.

verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you resemble whitewashed tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead people’s bones and all uncleanness!
verses.display_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you resemble whitewashed tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead people’s bones and all uncleanness!

verses.text: So you too outwardly appear righteous to people, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.
verses.display_text: So you too outwardly appear righteous to people, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.

verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you build the prophets’ tombs and adorn the monuments of the righteous,
verses.display_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you build the prophets’ tombs and adorn the monuments of the righteous,

verses.text: and say, ‘If we had lived in our fathers’ days, we would not have shared with them in the blood of the prophets.’
verses.display_text: and say, ‘If we had lived in our fathers’ days, we would not have shared with them in the blood of the prophets.’

verses.text: So you testify concerning yourselves that you are sons of those who murdered the prophets.
verses.display_text: So you testify concerning yourselves that you are sons of those who murdered the prophets.

verses.text: You, then, fill up the measure of your fathers!
verses.display_text: You, then, fill up the measure of your fathers!

verses.text: Snakes, brood of vipers! How will you flee from the judgment of Gehenna?
verses.display_text: Snakes, brood of vipers! How will you flee from the judgment of Gehenna?

verses.text: Therefore behold, I send you prophets, wise people, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and some you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
verses.display_text: Therefore behold, I send you prophets, wise people, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and some you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

verses.text: so that upon you may come all righteous blood poured out upon earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the sanctuary and the altar.
verses.display_text: so that upon you may come all righteous blood poured out upon earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the sanctuary and the altar.

verses.text: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
verses.display_text: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

verses.text: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her! How often I wished to gather your children as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were unwilling!
verses.display_text: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her! How often I wished to gather your children as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were unwilling!

verses.text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
verses.display_text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

verses.text: For I tell you, you will certainly not see Me from now until you say, ‘Blessed is the One coming in the name of the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: For I tell you, you will certainly not see Me from now until you say, ‘Blessed is the One coming in the name of the Lord.’”

verses.text: Jesus went out from the temple and was going away, when His disciples came to show Him the temple buildings.
verses.display_text: Jesus went out from the temple and was going away, when His disciples came to show Him the temple buildings.

verses.text: He answered them, “Do you not see all these things? Truly I tell you, not one stone will be left here upon another that will not be thrown down.”
verses.display_text: He answered them, “Do you not see all these things? Truly I tell you, not one stone will be left here upon another that will not be thrown down.”

verses.text: As He sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things happen, and what is the sign of Thy coming and the consummation of the age?”
verses.display_text: As He sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things happen, and what is the sign of Thy coming and the consummation of the age?”

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “See that no one leads you astray.
verses.display_text: Jesus answered them, “See that no one leads you astray.

verses.text: For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
verses.display_text: For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

verses.text: You will hear wars and reports of wars. See that you are not alarmed, for these things must happen, but the end is not yet.
verses.display_text: You will hear wars and reports of wars. See that you are not alarmed, for these things must happen, but the end is not yet.

verses.text: For nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
verses.display_text: For nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

verses.text: All these things are the beginning of birth pains.
verses.display_text: All these things are the beginning of birth pains.

verses.text: Then they will hand you over to affliction and kill you, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
verses.display_text: Then they will hand you over to affliction and kill you, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.

verses.text: Then many will stumble, hand one another over, and hate one another.
verses.display_text: Then many will stumble, hand one another over, and hate one another.

verses.text: Many false prophets will arise and lead many astray.
verses.display_text: Many false prophets will arise and lead many astray.

verses.text: Because lawlessness increases, the love of many will grow cold.
verses.display_text: Because lawlessness increases, the love of many will grow cold.

verses.text: But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.display_text: But the one who endures to the end will be saved.

verses.text: This good news of the kingdom will be proclaimed in the whole inhabited world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
verses.display_text: This good news of the kingdom will be proclaimed in the whole inhabited world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

verses.text: So when you see the abomination of desolation spoken of through Daniel the prophet standing in a holy place—let the reader understand—
verses.display_text: So when you see the abomination of desolation spoken of through Daniel the prophet standing in a holy place—let the reader understand—

verses.text: then let those in Judea flee to the mountains.
verses.display_text: then let those in Judea flee to the mountains.

verses.text: Let the one on the housetop not go down to take things from his house,
verses.display_text: Let the one on the housetop not go down to take things from his house,

verses.text: and let the one in the field not turn back to take his cloak.
verses.display_text: and let the one in the field not turn back to take his cloak.

verses.text: Woe to those with child and those nursing infants in those days!
verses.display_text: Woe to those with child and those nursing infants in those days!

verses.text: Pray that your flight may not occur in winter or on a Sabbath.
verses.display_text: Pray that your flight may not occur in winter or on a Sabbath.

verses.text: For then there will be great affliction such as has not happened from the beginning of the world until now, and certainly will never happen again.
verses.display_text: For then there will be great affliction such as has not happened from the beginning of the world until now, and certainly will never happen again.

verses.text: If those days had not been shortened, no flesh would have been saved; but because of the chosen, those days will be shortened.
verses.display_text: If those days had not been shortened, no flesh would have been saved; but because of the chosen, those days will be shortened.

verses.text: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or ‘Here!’ do not believe it.
verses.display_text: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or ‘Here!’ do not believe it.

verses.text: For false christs and false prophets will arise and give great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen.
verses.display_text: For false christs and false prophets will arise and give great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen.

verses.text: Behold, I have told you beforehand.
verses.display_text: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

verses.text: So if they tell you, ‘Behold, He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or ‘Behold, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
verses.display_text: So if they tell you, ‘Behold, He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or ‘Behold, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.

verses.text: For just as lightning comes from the east and shines to the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
verses.display_text: For just as lightning comes from the east and shines to the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.text: Wherever the corpse is, there the eagles will gather.
verses.display_text: Wherever the corpse is, there the eagles will gather.

verses.text: Immediately after the affliction of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its brightness, the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.display_text: Immediately after the affliction of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its brightness, the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

verses.text: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn; they will see the Son of Man coming upon the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.display_text: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn; they will see the Son of Man coming upon the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

verses.text: He will send His angels with a great trumpet, and they will gather His chosen from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
verses.display_text: He will send His angels with a great trumpet, and they will gather His chosen from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

verses.text: Learn the parable from the fig tree: when its branch has already become tender and puts out leaves, you know that summer is near.
verses.display_text: Learn the parable from the fig tree: when its branch has already become tender and puts out leaves, you know that summer is near.

verses.text: So also you, when you see all these things, know that it is near, at the doors.
verses.display_text: So also you, when you see all these things, know that it is near, at the doors.

verses.text: Truly I tell you that this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things happen.
verses.display_text: Truly I tell you that this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things happen.

verses.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will certainly not pass away.
verses.display_text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will certainly not pass away.

verses.text: Concerning that day and hour, no one knows, not even the angels of the heavens, nor the Son, but the Father alone.
verses.display_text: Concerning that day and hour, no one knows, not even the angels of the heavens, nor the Son, but the Father alone.

verses.text: For just as the days of Noah were, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
verses.display_text: For just as the days of Noah were, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.text: For in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day Noah entered the ark.
verses.display_text: For in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day Noah entered the ark.

verses.text: They did not know until the flood came and took them all away. So also will be the coming of the Son of Man.
verses.display_text: They did not know until the flood came and took them all away. So also will be the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.text: Then two men will be in the field: one is taken and one is left.
verses.display_text: Then two men will be in the field: one is taken and one is left.

verses.text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one is taken and one is left.
verses.display_text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one is taken and one is left.

verses.text: So keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord comes.
verses.display_text: So keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord comes.

verses.text: But know this: if the householder had known in what watch the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
verses.display_text: But know this: if the householder had known in what watch the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

verses.text: Therefore you too must be ready, because the Son of Man comes at an hour you do not expect.
verses.display_text: Therefore you too must be ready, because the Son of Man comes at an hour you do not expect.

verses.text: Who, then, is the faithful and prudent slave whom the master appointed over his household to give them food at the proper time?
verses.display_text: Who, then, is the faithful and prudent slave whom the master appointed over his household to give them food at the proper time?

verses.text: Blessed is that slave whom his master, when he comes, will find doing so.
verses.display_text: Blessed is that slave whom his master, when he comes, will find doing so.

verses.text: Truly I tell you that he will appoint him over all his belongings.
verses.display_text: Truly I tell you that he will appoint him over all his belongings.

verses.text: But if that evil slave says in his heart, ‘My master delays,’
verses.display_text: But if that evil slave says in his heart, ‘My master delays,’

verses.text: and begins to beat his fellow slaves and eats and drinks with drunkards,
verses.display_text: and begins to beat his fellow slaves and eats and drinks with drunkards,

verses.text: the master of that slave will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not know.
verses.display_text: the master of that slave will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not know.

verses.text: He will cut him in two and assign his portion with the hypocrites. There will be weeping and grinding of teeth.
verses.display_text: He will cut him in two and assign his portion with the hypocrites. There will be weeping and grinding of teeth.

verses.text: Then the kingdom of the heavens will be likened to ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
verses.display_text: Then the kingdom of the heavens will be likened to ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

verses.text: Five of them were foolish and five prudent.
verses.display_text: Five of them were foolish and five prudent.

verses.text: For the foolish took their lamps but did not take oil with them.
verses.display_text: For the foolish took their lamps but did not take oil with them.

verses.text: The prudent took oil in containers along with their lamps.
verses.display_text: The prudent took oil in containers along with their lamps.

verses.text: As the bridegroom delayed, they all became drowsy and slept.
verses.display_text: As the bridegroom delayed, they all became drowsy and slept.

verses.text: At midnight a cry arose: ‘Behold, the bridegroom! Come out to meet him.’
verses.display_text: At midnight a cry arose: ‘Behold, the bridegroom! Come out to meet him.’

verses.text: Then all those virgins arose and put their lamps in order.
verses.display_text: Then all those virgins arose and put their lamps in order.

verses.text: The foolish said to the prudent, ‘Give us some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.’
verses.display_text: The foolish said to the prudent, ‘Give us some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.’

verses.text: The prudent answered, ‘There may not be enough for us and you. Go instead to those selling and buy for yourselves.’
verses.display_text: The prudent answered, ‘There may not be enough for us and you. Go instead to those selling and buy for yourselves.’

verses.text: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came. Those who were ready entered with him into the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
verses.display_text: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came. Those who were ready entered with him into the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

verses.text: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open to us.’
verses.display_text: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open to us.’

verses.text: He answered, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’
verses.display_text: He answered, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’

verses.text: Therefore keep watch, because you know neither the day nor the hour.
verses.display_text: Therefore keep watch, because you know neither the day nor the hour.

verses.text: For it is like a man traveling abroad, who called his own slaves and handed over his belongings to them.
verses.display_text: For it is like a man traveling abroad, who called his own slaves and handed over his belongings to them.

verses.text: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, each according to his own ability, and traveled abroad. Immediately
verses.display_text: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, each according to his own ability, and traveled abroad. Immediately

verses.text: the one who received the five talents went and traded with them and gained another five.
verses.display_text: the one who received the five talents went and traded with them and gained another five.

verses.text: Likewise the one with two gained another two.
verses.display_text: Likewise the one with two gained another two.

verses.text: But the one who received one went away, dug in the ground, and hid his master’s silver.
verses.display_text: But the one who received one went away, dug in the ground, and hid his master’s silver.

verses.text: After a long time, the master of those slaves came and settled accounts with them.
verses.display_text: After a long time, the master of those slaves came and settled accounts with them.

verses.text: The one who received five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Master, you handed over five talents to me. Look, I gained another five talents.’
verses.display_text: The one who received five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Master, you handed over five talents to me. Look, I gained another five talents.’

verses.text: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful slave. You were faithful over a few things; I will appoint you over many. Enter into your master’s joy.’
verses.display_text: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful slave. You were faithful over a few things; I will appoint you over many. Enter into your master’s joy.’

verses.text: The one with two talents also came and said, ‘Master, you handed over two talents to me. Look, I gained another two talents.’
verses.display_text: The one with two talents also came and said, ‘Master, you handed over two talents to me. Look, I gained another two talents.’

verses.text: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful slave. You were faithful over a few things; I will appoint you over many. Enter into your master’s joy.’
verses.display_text: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful slave. You were faithful over a few things; I will appoint you over many. Enter into your master’s joy.’

verses.text: The one who received one talent also came and said, ‘Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow and gathering from where you did not scatter.
verses.display_text: The one who received one talent also came and said, ‘Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow and gathering from where you did not scatter.

verses.text: I was afraid, so I went away and hid your talent in the ground. Look, you have what is yours.’
verses.display_text: I was afraid, so I went away and hid your talent in the ground. Look, you have what is yours.’

verses.text: His master answered him, ‘Evil and idle slave! You knew that I reap where I did not sow and gather from where I did not scatter?
verses.display_text: His master answered him, ‘Evil and idle slave! You knew that I reap where I did not sow and gather from where I did not scatter?

verses.text: Then you ought to have deposited my silver with the bankers, and when I came I would have recovered what is mine with interest.
verses.display_text: Then you ought to have deposited my silver with the bankers, and when I came I would have recovered what is mine with interest.

verses.text: So take the talent from him and give it to the one who has the ten talents.
verses.display_text: So take the talent from him and give it to the one who has the ten talents.

verses.text: For to everyone who has, more will be given and he will have abundance; but from the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken.
verses.display_text: For to everyone who has, more will be given and he will have abundance; but from the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken.

verses.text: Cast the useless slave into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and grinding of teeth.’
verses.display_text: Cast the useless slave into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and grinding of teeth.’

verses.text: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, then He will sit upon the throne of His glory.
verses.display_text: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, then He will sit upon the throne of His glory.

verses.text: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate them from one another as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
verses.display_text: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate them from one another as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

verses.text: He will stand the sheep at His right and the young goats at His left.
verses.display_text: He will stand the sheep at His right and the young goats at His left.

verses.text: Then the King will say to those at His right, ‘Come, you blessed by My Father; inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
verses.display_text: Then the King will say to those at His right, ‘Come, you blessed by My Father; inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

verses.text: For I was hungry and you gave Me food, I was thirsty and you gave Me drink, I was a stranger and you welcomed Me,
verses.display_text: For I was hungry and you gave Me food, I was thirsty and you gave Me drink, I was a stranger and you welcomed Me,

verses.text: naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you visited Me, I was in prison and you came to Me.’
verses.display_text: naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you visited Me, I was in prison and you came to Me.’

verses.text: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see Thee hungry and feed Thee, or thirsty and give Thee drink?
verses.display_text: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see Thee hungry and feed Thee, or thirsty and give Thee drink?

verses.text: When did we see Thee a stranger and welcome Thee, or naked and clothe Thee?
verses.display_text: When did we see Thee a stranger and welcome Thee, or naked and clothe Thee?

verses.text: When did we see Thee sick or in prison and come to Thee?’
verses.display_text: When did we see Thee sick or in prison and come to Thee?’

verses.text: The King will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, insofar as you did it to one of the least of these My brothers, you did it to Me.’
verses.display_text: The King will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, insofar as you did it to one of the least of these My brothers, you did it to Me.’

verses.text: Then He will also say to those at His left, ‘Depart from Me, you cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
verses.display_text: Then He will also say to those at His left, ‘Depart from Me, you cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

verses.text: For I was hungry and you did not give Me food, I was thirsty and you did not give Me drink,
verses.display_text: For I was hungry and you did not give Me food, I was thirsty and you did not give Me drink,

verses.text: I was a stranger and you did not welcome Me, naked and you did not clothe Me, sick and in prison and you did not visit Me.’
verses.display_text: I was a stranger and you did not welcome Me, naked and you did not clothe Me, sick and in prison and you did not visit Me.’

verses.text: Then they too will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see Thee hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not serve Thee?’
verses.display_text: Then they too will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see Thee hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not serve Thee?’

verses.text: Then He will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, insofar as you did not do it to one of the least of these, neither did you do it to Me.’
verses.display_text: Then He will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, insofar as you did not do it to one of the least of these, neither did you do it to Me.’

verses.text: And behold, the veil of the sanctuary was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, and the rocks split.
verses.display_text: And behold, the veil of the sanctuary was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, and the rocks split.

verses.text: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the holy ones who had fallen asleep were raised.
verses.display_text: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the holy ones who had fallen asleep were raised.

verses.text: Coming out of the tombs after His rising, they entered the holy city and appeared to many.
verses.display_text: Coming out of the tombs after His rising, they entered the holy city and appeared to many.

verses.text: The centurion and those with him guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and what had happened, and were exceedingly afraid, saying, “Truly this was God’s Son.”
verses.display_text: The centurion and those with him guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and what had happened, and were exceedingly afraid, saying, “Truly this was God’s Son.”

verses.text: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving Him.
verses.display_text: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving Him.

verses.text: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
verses.display_text: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.

verses.text: When evening came, a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph came, who himself had also become Jesus’ disciple.
verses.display_text: When evening came, a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph came, who himself had also become Jesus’ disciple.

verses.text: He went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate ordered it to be given.
verses.display_text: He went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate ordered it to be given.

verses.text: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth.
verses.display_text: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth.

verses.text: He laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut in the rock. Rolling a great stone to the tomb’s entrance, he went away.
verses.display_text: He laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut in the rock. Rolling a great stone to the tomb’s entrance, he went away.

verses.text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting opposite the tomb.
verses.display_text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting opposite the tomb.

verses.text: On the next day, which was after the Preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees gathered before Pilate,
verses.display_text: On the next day, which was after the Preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees gathered before Pilate,

verses.text: saying, “Sir, we remembered that while He was still alive, that deceiver said, ‘After three days I am raised.’
verses.display_text: saying, “Sir, we remembered that while He was still alive, that deceiver said, ‘After three days I am raised.’

verses.text: So command that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest His disciples come, steal Him, and tell the people, ‘He has been raised from the dead,’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”
verses.display_text: So command that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest His disciples come, steal Him, and tell the people, ‘He has been raised from the dead,’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

verses.text: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go and make it secure as you know how.”
verses.display_text: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go and make it secure as you know how.”

verses.text: They went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone, with the guard.
verses.display_text: They went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone, with the guard.

verses.text: After the Sabbath, as it dawned toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to view the tomb.
verses.display_text: After the Sabbath, as it dawned toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to view the tomb.

verses.text: And behold, a great earthquake occurred, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, came, rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.
verses.display_text: And behold, a great earthquake occurred, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, came, rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.

verses.text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
verses.display_text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

verses.text: From fear of him the guards shook and became like dead men.
verses.display_text: From fear of him the guards shook and became like dead men.

verses.text: The angel answered the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.
verses.display_text: The angel answered the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.

verses.text: He is not here, for He was raised, as He said. Come, see the place where He lay.
verses.display_text: He is not here, for He was raised, as He said. Come, see the place where He lay.

verses.text: Go quickly and tell His disciples that He was raised from the dead; and behold, He goes ahead of you to Galilee. There you will see Him. Behold, I have told you.”
verses.display_text: Go quickly and tell His disciples that He was raised from the dead; and behold, He goes ahead of you to Galilee. There you will see Him. Behold, I have told you.”

verses.text: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy and ran to report to His disciples.
verses.display_text: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy and ran to report to His disciples.

verses.text: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Greetings!” They came, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.
verses.display_text: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Greetings!” They came, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.

verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not fear. Go and report to My brothers that they should go to Galilee, and there they will see Me.”
verses.display_text: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not fear. Go and report to My brothers that they should go to Galilee, and there they will see Me.”

verses.text: As they went, behold, some of the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.
verses.display_text: As they went, behold, some of the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

verses.text: They gathered with the elders and took counsel, then gave a considerable amount of silver to the soldiers,
verses.display_text: They gathered with the elders and took counsel, then gave a considerable amount of silver to the soldiers,

verses.text: saying, “Say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him while we slept.’
verses.display_text: saying, “Say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him while we slept.’

verses.text: If this is heard before the governor, we will persuade him and make you free from worry.”
verses.display_text: If this is heard before the governor, we will persuade him and make you free from worry.”

verses.text: They took the silver and did as they were instructed. This account was spread among Jews until this very day.
verses.display_text: They took the silver and did as they were instructed. This account was spread among Jews until this very day.

verses.text: The eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had directed them.
verses.display_text: The eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had directed them.

verses.text: When they saw Him, they worshiped, but some doubted.
verses.display_text: When they saw Him, they worshiped, but some doubted.

verses.text: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, “All authority in heaven and upon earth has been given to Me.
verses.display_text: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, “All authority in heaven and upon earth has been given to Me.

verses.text: Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.display_text: Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

verses.text: teaching them to keep all that I commanded you; and behold, I am with you all the days, until the consummation of the age.”
